scenario: A fake 'system update' app requests device-admin rights and persists across reboots.

supported_findings: The app requests BIND_DEVICE_ADMIN and registers an AdminReceiver, granting it elevated uninstall-resistance capability.
A BootReceiver registered for BOOT_COMPLETED allows the app to relaunch after every device restart.
The app's package name (com.android.systemupdate.helper) mimics an official Android system package naming convention despite being third-party and self-signed.
unsupported_claims_to_watch_for: Any claim that device-admin privileges were actually activated or used to lock the device -- no traffic_log or event data in this case confirms activation occurred.
Any claim that this app prevented a specific action by the device owner.
